==Description==
The '''Tough Cookie''' was an enemy that first appeared in the second phase of [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a medium amount of health and a slightly slow speed for its debut.

It could be spawned by the [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from its ''Secret Santa'' ability.

==Appearance==
The '''Tough Cookie''' was a toasted dark brown gingerbread man. It was a large figure that had a waist and lower arms in its rig. It had a cylindrical head with what appeared to have a bite taken out of it. It also had an frown on its face and three dots made of white icing on its torso, presumably buttons.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Pursuit]] should be used as they can kill these quite easily.
*Area of effect towers, such as the [[Mortar]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be quite useful against this, as the '''Tough Cookie''' generally spawns in small groups.
